privacy:
Last Updated: July 20, 2026

By using Cozine, you agree to this Privacy Policy and our Terms of Service. Please read both documents carefully. If you do not agree, do not install or use the bot.

How We Collect Information

All information is collected through public data tracking and platform integration:

  • Discord Platform Data - We access publicly accessible member data, presence information, and shared security logs within mutual servers where Cozine has authorized access.
  • Roblox Public API - Public profile information to verify Roblox account status.

What We Collect

  • User IDs - Unique Discord identifiers
  • Guild IDs - Server identifiers where the bot is active
  • Roblox Account IDs - Unique Roblox identifiers linked to documented activity
  • Security Logs - Records of violations and exploit activity

How We Use Data

Data is used strictly to keep communities safe and identify users in violation of Discord or Roblox Terms of Service. This includes:

  • Checking new members against records of verified ToS violators
  • Sending alerts to moderators about potential threats
  • Keeping records of security violations

Data Retention & Deletion

We will delete your personal data upon request. However, we retain records of users documented to have violated Discord or Roblox Terms of Service, as deletion would prevent detection of repeat offenders and undermine platform safety. If you believe you were flagged in error, you can file an appeal through our support server and we will review your case. Successful appeals result in data deletion within one hour.

We recognize that security researchers, investigators, or innocent users may occasionally be flagged. If you believe your data was logged in error, you can easily file an appeal through our support server. Each case is reviewed manually.

Data Storage

  • Stored on secure servers with restricted access
  • Access is strictly limited to bot administrators
  • We do not sell or share your data with third parties.

Contact

For questions, data deletion requests, or to file an appeal, join our support server.
tos:
Last Updated: July 20, 2026

By using Cozine, you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. Please read both documents carefully. If you do not agree, do not install or use the bot.

What Cozine Does

Cozine monitors Discord servers and flags users who have been documented as violating Discord or Roblox Terms of Service. Specifically, we flag users for:

  • Exploiting game mechanics in Roblox games
  • Using Roblox cheats or hacks
  • Violating Discord's Terms of Service in ways that affect community safety

Servers can opt-in to receive automated notifications using the designated setup command. When a flagged user joins a configured server, moderators will receive an alert. We are not responsible for individual server ban decisions. Moderators make the final call on whether to take action.

Payment Terms & Account Access

By purchasing access to Cozine, you explicitly agree to the following terms. Running the /skid command requires you to confirm agreement prior to finalizing payment:

  • Strict Restrictions: You may use the bot to expose exploiters, but you are strictly prohibited from using it to harass, threaten, dox, or incite action against them.
  • No Tampering: You may not reverse engineer, bypass, or attempt to bypass the bot's restrictions, limitations, or protections.
  • No Facilitation: You are prohibited from helping exploiters evade detection or avoid consequences.
  • Account Locking: Purchased access is bound to the purchasing Discord account and is non-transferable, except in cases of account compromise or permanent deletion with verified evidence provided, at our sole discretion, sharing or gifting access to others is strictly prohibited.
  • No-Refund Revocation: Violating any of these rules will result in immediate termination of access without a refund, regardless of whether your payment period has already started.

Accuracy & Appeals

Our flags are 100% accurate based on documented evidence. However, if you believe you were flagged in error, you can appeal through our support server. Appeals are reviewed within 48 hours during normal operations. Response times may extend to several weeks during high volume periods. See our Privacy Policy for the full appeals process.

Acceptable Use

  • Use the bot only for legitimate server moderation and safety
  • Do not use the bot to harass, target, or discriminate against users
  • Respect Discord and Roblox Terms of Service when using this bot
  • Do not attempt to manipulate or abuse the alert system

Prohibited Actions

  • Using the bot outside of moderation purposes
  • Attempting to reverse engineer or extract data
  • Sharing false reports to get users flagged

Service Disclaimer

Cozine is provided "as-is" without guaranteed uptime. We are not liable for:

  • Server disruptions or downtime
  • Missed threats or exploiters we fail to detect
  • Actions taken by moderators based on bot alerts

Eligibility

  • Must be 13+ years old (Discord's minimum age)
  • Must comply with Discord's Terms of Service

Flagged Users

Any user flagged by Cozine is automatically restricted from using the bot. This restriction remains in effect until the user files an appeal through our support server and the appeal is approved. Flagged users attempting to use the bot will be unable to access its features.

Termination

We reserve the right to revoke access to Cozine at any time for:

  • Violating these Terms of Service
  • Abuse of the alert system or appeals process
  • Using the bot outside of legitimate moderation purposes
  • Harassment or targeting of users

Changes to Terms

We may update these Terms of Service at any time. We will notify users of significant changes through our support server. Your continued use of Cozine after changes constitute acceptance of the updated terms.

Agreement & Privacy

For information about how we collect, store, and use data, see our Privacy Policy.

Contact

For questions, appeals, or other concerns, join our support server.
api-tos:
Last Updated: September 12, 2026

By using the Cozine API, you agree to our main Terms of Service plus the additional terms below. If you don't agree, don't use it.

Access

API access is not open to everyone. You need to join our support server and ask for a key. We review requests individually and can deny or revoke access for any reason. There is no payment involved - access is granted at our discretion.

Keys

  • Your key is tied to your Discord account. Don't share it.
  • If your key leaks or gets compromised, tell us immediately so we can rotate it.
  • Sharing, selling, or posting your key publicly = we pull it. No discussion.

Rate Limits

  • Every key has a request cap. If you hit it, you'll get a 429 response and have to wait.
  • If you're deliberately working around the limits (spinning up multiple keys, distributing requests across accounts, whatever), we'll revoke your access.

What You Can Do

  • Pull your own guild's data
  • Look up user records for moderation
  • Build tools on top of it as long as you're not being shady about it

What You Can't Do

  • Scrape everything and dump it somewhere
  • Resell the data
  • Use it to target, harass, or dox anyone
  • Try to reverse engineer how it works
  • Use it for anything that isn't moderation

Data

  • We don't sell your data.
  • For data deletion and appeals, see our Privacy Policy

Downtime & Liability

The API might go down. We're not on the hook for:

  • Outages or slow responses
  • Anything you built that stopped working because we had an outage

Termination

We can pull your key whenever we want if you're breaking these terms. If you think it was unfair, come argue your case in the support server.

Changes

We can update these terms whenever. We'll post in the support server if anything major changes. Keep using the API and that counts as agreeing to the new terms.

Contact

Questions? Support server.
